youtube.aciklama: The classic pure tone average (PTA) is the average of air conduction thresholds at 500, 1000 and 2000 Hz; the World Health Organization and many current sources add 4000 Hz and use a four-frequency average. With thresholds of 20, 30, 40 and 60 dB HL, the average is 30 or 37.5 dB HL, so the report must state which frequencies were used to calculate the PTA.
